The method body is unchanged."}], "notes": "The collection failure comes from the `__post_init_post_parse__` hook, which v2 drops and warns about at decoration time (the traceback points at the decorator line). The unused `StrictConfig` class is not passed to the dataclass and does not trigger the failure, so it is left unchanged. No pydantic models exist in the repo, so no other files are affected."}
